PackPage.title: Pack into ABA
PackPage.hint_body: The input should be a plain resource directory produced by MeidoSerialization, whose first-level subdirectories are named after Unity types (Texture2D, TextAsset, Mesh, and so on). Packing always emits a Unity 2022.3.35f1 ABA together with its companion .ct in the same place. Keep the bundle name lowercase: KCES 1.34.5 looks containers up without lowercasing the name, so an uppercase letter leaves the MOD loaded with no parts at all.
PackPage.source_dir_placeholder: Choose or paste a plain resource directory
PackPage.output_name_extra: Both the .aba and the .ct are written to the parent of the source directory
PackPage.missing_input: Choose a source directory and enter an output base name first
